sections.title: Overview
sections.content: You Loong, Blackwater Crew Leader (游龙) is an optional encounter in Pangzhen, found at Green Serpent House, then the water to the west. Beating it yields You Loong's Deluge / Loong Trident.

sections.title: Where to Find the You Loong, Blackwater Crew Leader (游龙)
sections.content:
Location: Green Serpent House, then the water to the west.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the You Loong, Blackwater Crew Leader (游龙)
sections.content:
What works

  • Defeating him gives You Loong's Deluge, which is the answer to several fire hazards later.
  • Second encounter happens across the water west of Green Serpent House.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 29 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear (长鸿). After it: Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster (舞狮尊主 烈焰). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
